title: Preserve background-service failures at the host boundary
goal: Preserve background importer failures at the process boundary when the default Generic Host stops, while distinguishing cancellation, Ignore, logs and the chosen exit code.

Use the application validation/exit policy described by the recipe.
constraints: Paired real processes: 35 lifecycle children plus canonical demo per release. Run/RunAsync, explicit start/stop, timed stop and sync/async shutdown waits; signalled single/multiple/shutdown failures with original identities, logs and exit policy, normal cancellation, Ignore nonshutdown, startup failure, disposal and child reaping. Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT; no browser/custom-host/uncaught numeric-exit/older-target-newer-package/GA proof.
